provenance.sdk_matches: All 18 local back.webp/mask.webp/layout blobs verified against live Android googlesource directory entries.

coordinate_conventions.frame: Uncropped source pixels, origin top-left, x right/y down. These six frame crops start at (0,0). Bounds use xyxy, rectangles xywh.
coordinate_conventions.millimetres: Height-anchored uniform scale; body center origin, x right/y up. Cutouts are relative to viewport center. Hardware dims and native OLED aspect retained.
coordinate_conventions.body_outline: Existing body contour is normalized independently to preserved published width/height by build.fit_outline; screen scale remains uniform. Do not stretch OLED horizontally to absorb body artwork discrepancy.
coordinate_conventions.seams: center_axis_mm is x for top/bottom, y for left/right. Intervals are approximate visible artwork bands, not fabricated insert CAD. mm values are image conversion, not manufacturing precision.

original_fold_scale.trace_action: Existing trace body bounds/scale and contours already correct; retained. Profile synchronized to trace.
original_fold_scale.normalization: Use median opaque extents over x=40..60% of artwork, not a single center column intersecting the hinge notch. Canvas height 2087 includes a final antialias fringe, not an extra body millimetre scale pixel.

verification.folded_unfolded_cover_link: pass: identical native size and aperture list, mirrored X, identical Y across all four pairs; frame_center_mm equals corresponding closed trace center
verification.source_check_method: Executed only AST-extracted load_trace/fit_outline/traced_screen/apply_trace functions, with a geometry module stub and real Shapely. No bpy import or Blender process. This checks data consumption, not exported mesh geometry.

parent_integration.instruction: After legacy measurements, use assigned trace.screen_rect_mm for each display; use closed trace for both cover states, subtract Cover half center x=.3 for folded local placement and mirror it for unfolded. Preserve center Z. Copy screen_cutouts_mm from the same trace. Synchronize frame_center_mm from the closed trace. Copy the exact scalar/front-camera changes listed per device; do not regenerate from the old 2038 px center-column measurement.

parent_integration.location: trace and measurement source feeding make_pixel_profiles
parent_integration.instruction: Current trace() already uses correct multi-column body extents and extracts internal alpha islands; regenerate only these assigned official traces if needed. Preserve native layout width/height, body contour and OLED contour independently. Ensure measurement generator uses the same 2086 px OG body anchor. Do not regenerate derived 11 art as official.

Cover glass needs its own contour; existing constant OLED expansion of 1.8 mm OG /1.5 mm other Folds cannot represent hinge-side metal. Use measured straight rail/glass stations plus the original artwork to trace corner and top speaker deviations, retaining separate screen_outline_mm. In unfolded state mirror cover glass in panel-local X with the cover OLED; do not rescale either OLED UV or body envelope. Keep inner dark surround distinct from exposed rail and terminate it at hinge, not with a continuous band across the crease.

Use only measured intervals in this report. Convert the folded front-body coordinates to Cover half local coordinates, then mirror for rear-facing unfolded cover. Clip to enclosure rail faces; follow actual rolled surface without changing slab bounds or underlying body silhouette. Attach to leaf so Fold animation/recenter carries them. Preserve material palettes; use a distinct nonmetallic polymer role tinted to finish, with roughness as an acknowledged rendering estimate. Do not infer depth or unknown opposite-leaf seams.

parent_integration.location: prepare_screen selfie disk construction and geometry bezel camera
parent_integration.instruction: Consume measured screen_cutouts_mm for existing create_cutouts branch. Replace flat disk with shallow recessed barrel + optical glass layers entirely within measured aperture; internal dimensions remain illustrative. Cover optics must mirror with the rear-facing cover and follow leaf parent. OG separate bezel camera stays outside the OLED and on Camera half. Do not alter reviewed rear camera assembly or inject hypothetical 11 cutouts.

Retain full official body contour, independently traced OLED and existing split/hinge transforms. Cover folded reference contains hinge-side asymmetric metal; do not independently stretch the same screen to both leaf widths. Keep cover-frame.svg linked to the same corrected closed frame while using folded.profile screen center and mirrored unfolded center. No helper should move the hinge axis, recenter, or reviewed dimensions.

Run assigned profile checks and actual GLB contour comparison at max .10 mm against traced body; inspect native UV/aspect, inner and cover apertures, frame.svg and cover-frame.svg alpha islands, true metal/glass boundaries, and Fold open/mid/closed poses. Existing GLBs measured here predate corrections; report is not artifact acceptance.
